visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair and bangs, wearing a black sports bra, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. Behind her is a minimalist white shelf. She introduces the topic of an underwear comparison. (2) She holds up a pair of grey MUJI underwear, stretching the fabric to show its texture. The camera focuses on the material as she points out the waistband. (3) The scene shifts to a waist-down view where she wears the grey underwear over her hips, demonstrating that the side bands are slightly tight on her skin. (4) She holds up a pair of black UNIQLO cotton underwear, then the scene cuts to her wearing them. She demonstrates the fit by turning around, showing front and back views while wearing light-colored leggings to show visible panty lines. (5) She displays a dark grey UNIQLO seamless pair, followed by a waist-down demonstration where she stretches the fabric to show its elasticity. (6) She introduces a brown 24Hrs seamless pair, showing its back profile while wearing leggings to prove it is truly seamless. (7) Finally, she presents a cream-colored 24Hrs 'mask' underwear, stretching it significantly between her hands to highlight its thinness and high elasticity before wearing it and showing her satisfaction.
